contract: Every ownerRead monotonically owns a read generation; ownerAction invalidates preceding reads. Only latest eligible success/error may mutate state or pending cache. Validate response identity, exact ledger metadata relationships and monotonic unchanged history prefix before mutation. Same sequence may legally change to STALE/EXPIRED or regain current content authorization without severity ordering.
required_guards: All success/error/caller catch/finally paths must preserve read ownership; checking only render path is insufficient
Awaited hash validation must recheck ownership before pending deletion or render
Top-level project/principal/app identity needs metadata-only server projection even when content is unavailable or history empty
history length matches safe integer sequence; contiguous chain, scoped rows, unique IDs/keys, kind/status and exact latest/record/recovered relations
recovered must bind requested key regardless of pending cache presence
No automatic POST or source/permission expansion
actual_http_future_cases: Delayed initial ACCEPTED, another session REVOKE, refresh returns newer first, release old success
Delayed initial ACCEPTED, another session new PREPARE, refresh returns newer first, release old success
Delayed initial error superseded by successful manual refresh
Read invalidated by starting action or by a newer key read; hash await supersession
controlled_future_cases: Wrong identity/version/publication/semantic flags, malformed ledger shape, wrong recovered key, payload/hash mismatch
Lower sequence and altered prefix rejected without clearing pending or draft
scope_boundaries: SQLite/actual Worker/IPC HTTP/JSDOM only after final freeze; no live provider/native browser/PG
No shared product writes or old evidence modifications
Pure review is not counted as test PASS
